answers.core:
Creating an add-on for a file type that is already supported feels kind of strange.
The addition is very small code wise, would not require a lot of work compared to writing a custom importer.
Easy to disable if you don't need vertex colours.
answers.workaround:
Other options are possible, but take more work
- Custom importer.
- Manually editing the import settings for a ton of GLTF2 files
- Writing a script that loads, and extracts each mesh from their respective  GLTF2 file.

title: Implement Blender-style vertex colour support for OBJ import
